title: Translation Invariance of Neural Operators for the FitzHugh-Nagumo Model
summary: Neural operators (NOs) are powerful deep learning frameworks designed to learn solution operators of partial differential equations. This study evaluates the ability of NOs' to capture the stiff spatio-temporal dynamics of the FitzHugh-Nagumo model. A key contribution of this study is the assessment of the translation invariance using a novel training strategy. Models are trained using an applied current with varying spatial locations and intensities at a fixed time, while the test set presents a challenging out-of-distribution scenario where the current is translated in both time and space.…
